message.subject: Complete outdoor graphics systems for Nazdar
message.body:
Hi [Name],

I saw Nazdar at PRINTING United and ISA Sign Expo—your focus on outdoor durability with the 2800 and 3500 Series really stood out.

We work with ink manufacturers whose customers face premature graphic failures and UV degradation issues. Our protective overlaminate helps transform those conversations from damage control into differentiated system solutions that hold up outdoors significantly longer.

Given your team's reach across 14+ SourceOne locations, this could be an interesting partnership angle for your sales reps. Would it make sense to send over some information on how other companies are positioning this as a complete outdoor graphics system?

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Nazdar's current outdoor durability claims limit competitiveness in premium markets where customers demand extended warranties
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Extreme durability and UV protection that enables Nazdar to position as complete outdoor graphics system provider
